hearthandharvest.jei.info.salt: Salt can be applied to any food to increase the hunger value it restores, while decreasing the saturation it provides
hearthandharvest.jei.info.watering_can: Watering cans can be charged with valid fertilizers by holding some in the off hand and clicking, and charged with water by clicking on a water source block. The watering can is used to apply a bone meal effect to a 3x3 area when clicked. It can also be used to extinguish fire and lit blocks.
hearthandharvest.jei.info.tree_tapper: Tree tappers can be placed on Spruce and Dark Oak trees to collect sap over time. Collect the sap with a bucket when full.
hearthandharvest.jei.info.sap_bucket: Sap buckets can be put into a cauldron, and when over fire will slowly boil down into syrup. This syrup can be collected using bottles.
hearthandharvest.jei.info.wild_grapes: Grapes can be commonly found as a wild plant in temperate lands, such as plains and forests.
hearthandharvest.jei.info.pluck_chickens: Shift-click on chickens bare handed to get some feathers, but beware that you may damage them! Use shears to avoid hurting them
hearthandharvest.jei.info.nest: Nests hold up to 9 stacks of items dropped into them. Chickens walk to nearby nests to lay their eggs, and wild Crows stash shiny items they steal. Right-click to take the top stack, sneak right-click to take everything, or right-click while holding an item to place it inside. Hoppers and comparators work with nests too
hearthandharvest.jei.info.scarecrow: Scarecrows work to help keep crows away from crops, just like Carved Pumpkins and Jack-o-Lanterns
hearthandharvest.jei.info.trough: Can be filled with either food or water. Filling it with animal food will cause them to automatically breed. Water will cause babies to grow up faster
hearthandharvest.jei.info.sprinkler: Can be filled with water and bonemeal to keep crops hydrated and randomly bonemeal them in a large area. Will also put out fires in its area
hearthandharvest.jei.info.salt_block: Will keep animals near, who will lick it. Will degrade over time, but can get repaired by adding more salt to it
hearthandharvest.jei.info.jug: Can be used like a bucket to pickup and move fluids. Holds 8 buckets at a time. Can be placed, extracted from, fill other containers, and be picked up with a shift-click
hearthandharvest.jei.info.cask: Ages juices into wine and pickles vegetables. Aging is faster in the dark and slower in bright light. Seal the cask to lock its ingredients so they cannot be disturbed while they age
hearthandharvest.jei.info.keg: Ferments juices into wine, milk into cheese, and vegetables into pickles. Put containers in the middle slot to fill or empty the tanks, using the button to switch mode
hearthandharvest.jei.info.vintage_aging: Put a finished item back into a cask to age it further. Each stage (Aged, Fine, Reserve) lengthens its effects and makes alcohol less likely to leave you drunk

jei.hearthandharvest.info.dough: Wheat can be turned into Dough by crafting it with a Water Bucket. But don't worry, the bucket's water won't be depleted!
jei.hearthandharvest.info.straw: A dry plant fiber used in crafting. Obtained by cutting grassy crops and plants with a Knife.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.knife:
A lightweight melee weapon, with fast swings and gentle damage.

They can harvest Straw from grasses, and guarantee secondary drops from animals.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.ham:
A large cut of meat from a Pig or Hoglin's leg.

You will need something lighter than a Sword to cut one...
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_cabbages: Cabbages can be commonly found as a wild plant in beach coasts.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_beetroots: Beetroot can be commonly found as a wild plant in beach coasts.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_carrots: Carrots can be commonly found as a wild plant in temperate lands, such as plains and forests.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_onions: Onions can be commonly found as a wild plant in temperate lands, such as plains and forests.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_potatoes: Potatoes can be commonly found as a wild plant in cold lands, such as mountains and taigas.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_tomatoes: Tomatoes can be commonly found as a wild plant in arid lands, such as savannas and deserts.
jei.hearthandharvest.info.wild_rice: Rice can be commonly found as a wild plant in the ponds of wet lands, such as swamps and jungles.
